submissions.title: data(providers): link FileDrive official GraphSplit usage guide
submissions.body:
## Summary

Fill FileDrive's currently blank `docs` value with its official GraphSplit usage guide:

- Provider: `filedrive`
- Source: `references/providers/providers.csv`
- Field: `docs` (blank → `https://github.com/filedrive-team/go-graphsplit#usage`)
- Scope: exactly one existing provider record and one field; no new listings or network-support claim.

## Evidence

1. FileDrive's current website and GitHub owner refer to the same upstream `filedrive-team/go-graphsplit` repository: https://github.com/filedrive-team/go-graphsplit
2. The first-party README contains a real `## Usage` section, including dataset splitting, `manifest.csv`, CAR/IPFS import, restoration, and PieceCID calculation: https://github.com/filedrive-team/go-graphsplit#usage
3. The existing canonical FileDrive provider description explicitly identifies GraphSplit and Filecoin. There is no change to that claim.
4. Verified exact compare against `Chain-Love/chain-love:main`: one commit ahead, zero behind; only `references/providers/providers.csv` changed.
5. PR #3966 updates `filedrive` contact/social fields, **not `docs`**. These are complementary but same-row changes; maintainers may need to preserve both patches during merging.
6. Checked relevant open PR search for a FileDrive documentation-field update; none identified. Link and contents checked October 11, 2026.

## Bounty eligibility and disclosure

Filecoin was included in the current eligible-network window announced in https://github.com/Chain-Love/chain-love/discussions/41. Eligibility and any remuneration remain entirely subject to project maintainer decisions. No payout amount is presumed.

Public ERC-20 ETH Mainnet payout address: `0x897681c19c239b029fffde764d0d005fcd5d1f2d`.

Prepared with AI assistance. No claim of executing GraphSplit, obtaining maintainers' approval or performing full CI locally.
